name: Basil of Caesarea
bio:
Bishop of Caesarea in Cappadocia from 370, one of the three Cappadocian Fathers with his brother Gregory of Nyssa and his friend Gregory of Nazianzus; he defended the Nicene faith and wrote rules for monastic life that are still followed in the East.

His nine homilies on the Hexaemeron, the six days of creation, were preached in Lent to a congregation of working people, and read Genesis 1 alongside the natural science of his day. He is honoured as a saint in both East and West.
